title: Vehicle Body 6DOF
text: Two-axle vehicle body with translational and rotational motion, 8 inputs, 7 outputs; {Hitch forces} sets the create, {Hitch moments} sets the create, {Vehicle mass, m} sets the mass, {Longitudinal distance from center of mass to front axle, a} sets the distance, {Longitudinal distance from center of mass to rear axle, b} sets the distance, {Lateral distance from geometric centerline to center of mass, d} sets the distance, {Vertical distance from center of mass to axle plane, h} sets the distance, {Longitudinal distance from center of mass to hitch, dh}, {Lateral distance from geometric centerline to hitch, hl}, {Vertical distance from hitch to axle plane, hh} sets the distance, {Initial position in the inertial frame [Xeo,Yeo,Zeo], Xe_o} sets the position, {Initial velocity in body axes [xdot_o,ydot_o,zdot_o], xbdot_o} sets the velocity, {Initial Euler orientation [roll, pitch, yaw], eul_o} sets the rotation, {Initial body rotation rates [p,q,r], p_o} sets the rotation rate, {Chassis inertia tensor, Iveh} sets the inertia {Track widths [front,rear], w} sets the widths, {Mass, z1m} sets the mass, {Distance vector from front axle, z1R} sets the distance, {Inertia tensor, z1I} sets the inertia, {Mass, z2m} sets the mass, {Distance vector from front axle, z2R} sets the distance, {Inertia tensor, z2I} sets the inertia, {Mass, z3m} sets the mass, {Distance vector from front axle, z3R} sets the distance, {Inertia tensor, z3I} sets the inertia, {Mass, z4m} sets the mass, {Distance vector from front axle, z4R} sets the distance, {Inertia tensor, z4I} sets the inertia, {Mass, z5m} sets the mass, {Distance vector from front axle, z5R} sets the distance, {Inertia tensor, z5I} sets the inertia, {Mass, z6m} sets the mass, {Distance vector from front axle, z6R} sets the distance, {Inertia tensor, z6I} sets the inertia, {Mass, z7m} sets the mass, {Distance vector from front axle, z7R} sets the distance, {Inertia tensor, z7I} sets the inertia, {Longitudinal drag area, Af} sets the area, {Longitudinal drag coefficient, Cd} sets the drag .3, {Longitudinal lift coefficient, Cl} sets the lift .1, {Longitudinal drag pitch moment, Cpm} sets the pitch drag .1, {Relative wind angle vector, beta_w} sets the wind angle, {Side force coefficient vector, Cs} sets the side force drag, {Yaw moment coefficient vector, Cym} sets the yaw moment drag, {Absolute Pressure, Pabs}, {Air temperature, Tair} sets the ambient air temperature, {Gravitational acceleration, g} sets the gravity, {Longitudinal velocity tolerance, xdot_tol} sets the tolerance .1, {Geometric longitudinal offset from axle plane, longOff} sets the longitudinal offset, {Geometric lateral offset from center plane, latOff} sets the lateral offset, {Geometric vertical offset from axle plane, vertOff} sets the vertical offset and {Wrap Euler angles, wrapAng} sets the selection. Values come from the instance.
